conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding quality tech names. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, balancing growth with risk management.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing.
